purpose: Ingest non-physics and cross-domain sources surfaced by the 00130/10030/01030/30410/43010/04013 raw scan, including industrial interoperability, agentic manufacturing, workforce governance, certified reference materials, SAP security and GMP/supply-chain intelligence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, alternate database pages and derivative copies of the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Specification numbers, DOI components, CVE IDs, product/catalog IDs and postal codes may carry substantial Worldshepherd utility but have zero automatic Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: OPC Unified Architecture - Common Object Model: ISA-95
sources.note: Use as the industrial interoperability model for mapping ISA-95 objects/properties/equipment/material concepts into OPC UA types and references. 10030 is the specification number.

sources.title: An agent architecture for manufacturing control: manAge
sources.authority: Computers in Industry / VTT research record
sources.note: Use distributed agent control, persistent data, disturbance handling and failure recovery as a historical architecture reference for agentic manufacturing orchestration. 00130 is DOI metadata.

sources.title: A network approach to operate agile manufacturing systems
sources.note: Use distributed manufacturing-center collaboration and contingency planning as a networked-production operating-model reference. 00130 is DOI metadata.

sources.title: ISO/TS 30410:2018 — Human resource management — Impact of hire metric
sources.note: Use workforce segmentation and critical-position impact measurement as a governance/workforce-planning reference. 30410 is the standard number.

sources.title: Styrene Certified Reference Material
sources.note: Use as an analytical-calibration/reference-material example with certificate/lot traceability and declared concentration. 30410 is the catalog number, not the concentration.

sources.title: CVE-2025-43010 — SAP S/4HANA SCM Master Data Layer code injection
sources.note: Use as a production/SCM integrity-control case: authenticated code injection can replace ABAP programs and cause high integrity/availability impact. 43010 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: Leminorella richardii — ATCC 43010
sources.note: Use custody, certificate, handling, biosafety and licensing metadata as a governed biological-material chain-of-custody reference. 43010 is the catalog identifier.

sources.title: 2025 GMP certificates for pharmaceutical manufacturers in postal zone 04013, Italy
sources.note: Use current GMP inspection/certificate structure as manufacturing-compliance and supplier/partner due-diligence intelligence. 04013 is the manufacturing-site postal code.

sources.title: Cost estimation model in early stage of design through implant miniplate complexity process index
sources.authority: E3S Web of Conferences / Universitas Indonesia record
sources.note: Use early design complexity-to-cost estimation as a manufacturing economics reference. 01030 is article/DOI metadata.

information_updates.finding: OPC 10030 provides an implementation-level bridge between ISA-95 manufacturing semantics and OPC UA, including logical equipment versus physical assets and explicit typed references.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Industrial-model utility is independent of Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: The 2001 manAge/NetMan literature supplies useful historical architecture patterns for distributed manufacturing agents, persistent state, local/global goal management, disturbance recovery and networked production-center coordination.

CVE-2025-43010 demonstrates that master-data and production-planning systems themselves are cybersecurity attack surfaces; integrity controls must protect manufacturing semantics and executable business logic, not just network boundaries.

next_actions: Continue raw coverage through 10443, 41340, 34041, 43941, 94143 and 19344 while retaining cross-domain utility.
Map OPC 10030 and S3000L concepts into Worldshepherd production/lifecycle data architecture as implementation candidates, not claimed compliance.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates.
